youtube_title: Bee Swarm Chasing You: Jump in Water or Run? Brave vs Normal #21 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BRAVE vs NORMAL — WHO'S RIGHT? #21. A swarm of bees is chasing you in the park. Brave jumps into the pond, Normal covers his face and runs inside. Who is right?
Answer: Normal. Bees hover above the water and wait for you to come up for air. US CDC / NIOSH advice: run away, get indoors, do not jump into water, cover your face and don't swat.
Source: US CDC / NIOSH, stinging insects safety advice.
